  if ! check_port "$port"; then
    overall_status=1

  # Also print simple status to stdout for local runs
  for port in "${!PORT_STATUS[@]}"; do
    if [[ "${PORT_STATUS[$port]}" == "up" ]]; then
      echo "[OK] Service on port ${port} is responding."
    else
      echo "[FAIL] Service on port ${port} is NOT responding."
    fi
  done
}

main "$@"
